name: apc-mk1-utility
description: APC mini mk1 clip editor. Reads the mk1 over Web MIDI and edits the currently-selected clip in Ableton Live directly via AbletonOSC (packages/osc-bridge) — real transpose/quantize/transform/generate on clip notes, driven by fader banks (Pitch/Time/Transform/Generate/Clip Tools), no MIDI mapping step.
